Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next step to get your infra and platform teams aligned:

What we heard
- You have a PoC goal to reduce inference cost per request and improve 99th pct latency for your document-search assistant.
- Primary stakeholders: Product (Alex), Cloud/Infra (TBD), Security (TBD).
- Constraints: VPC-only deployment and SOC2 evidence for data handling.

Proposed next step
- 30-minute technical walkthrough aimed at: 1) confirming infra requirements (VPC, networking), 2) demoing a compact workload on Redwood Dedicated, and 3) listing success criteria for a short PoC.

I can propose three windows next week (all PT):
1) Tue 6/29 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed 6/30 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu 7/1 11:30–12:00 PM PT

Please pick two that work for your team and indicate who from infra/security should join.

Success criteria we suggest for the meeting (so we have a crisp goal):
- Confirmed list of infra owners and an NDA/POC contact.
- Agreement on a representative dataset to use for the short demo.
- Clear follow-up: mutual action plan with timeline and SLA/contract touchpoints.

I've attached a short 1‑pager (redwood-30m-overview.pdf) that frames the walkthrough agenda and the items we'll need from your side. Also putting a shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefExample

Thanks — happy to be flexible on times.

Best,
